arbitration_venue.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
arbitration_venue.v: Binding arbitration before JAMS in Collin County, Texas under the United States Arbitration Act, 9 U.S.C. sec 1, single arbitrator, each party bearing its own costs and half the arbitrator's fees. Governing law: Texas. Any judicial action in aid of arbitration must be filed exclusively in state or federal courts with jurisdiction over Collin County, Texas.

claims_administrator.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
claims_administrator.v: GHDP claims are processed by Merchant's Benefits Administrators (MBA).

states.v: States Available: AK, AL, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, HI, IA, ID, IL, KS, KY, MA, MT, NJ, NM, RI, TX, UT, WY (21 states).

preventive.v: ACA section 2713 preventive list, itemised on the page: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm Screening; Adult Annual Standard Physical; Alcohol Misuse screening and counseling; Aspirin preventive medication; Bacteriuria Screening; BRCA Risk Assessment and Genetic Counseling/Testing; Breast Cancer Screening; Breastfeeding Support, Supplies and Counseling; Cervical Cancer Screening (Cytology/Pap, and Cytology+HPV); Chlamydia Screening; Colorectal Cancer Screening (subject to an at-home test kit for initial screening; colonoscopy benefits only if positive); Contraceptive Methods and Counseling; Dental Caries Prevention (infants and children up to age 5); Depression Screening; Diabetes Screening; Fall Prevention (older adults); Folic Acid Supplementation; Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Screening; Gonorrhea Prophylactic Medication; Gonorrhea Screening; Healthy Diet and Physical Activity Counseling; Hemoglobinopathies Screening; Hepatitis B Screening; Hepatitis C Screening; High Blood Pressure Screening; HIV Preexposure Prophylaxis; HIV Screening; Hypothyroidism Screening; Intimate Partner Violence Screening; Lung Cancer Screening; Obesity Screening and Counseling; Osteoporosis Screening; Phenylketonuria Screening; Preeclampsia Screening; Rh Incompatibility Screening (first pregnancy visit, and 24-28 weeks); Sexually Transmitted Infections Counseling; Skin Cancer Behavioral Counseling; Statin Preventive Medication; Syphilis Screening; Tobacco Use Counseling and Interventions; Tuberculosis Screening; Vision Screening; Well-Child Visits; Well-Woman Visits.

wellness.v: 1 visit per year, $25 copay, $150 maximum per visit

brochure.v: A brochure EXISTS and is linked: MEC_GHDP_Wellness1.pdf

dependent_rules.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
dependent_rules.v: Dependent children may remain on a parent's plan until age 26; at 26 they are termed and may enroll as Primary on their own plan.

eligibility_model.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
eligibility_model.v: Eligibility runs through a LIMITED PARTNERSHIP. The enrollee becomes a Limited Partner or Affiliate in GHD, Limited Partnership (general partner: Good Health Distribution Partners, LLC) and only then may enroll in the GHDP Plan. Verbatim: 'I understand that I am required to join and consent to all of the terms of the GHD Limited Partnership first and that allows me access to enroll in the GHD LP Health Plans.'

network.v: First Health Network. Provider search: www.locateprovidersnow.com

product_type.v: The Info page states verbatim: 'This is not a major medical plan nor a replacement for a major medical plan.' It describes a group health plan limited to ACA-required preventive and wellness services plus listed extras. Structurally an MEC-style preventive plan, not indemnity and not major medical.

addons.complementary_benefits.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
addons.complementary_benefits.v: Complementary benefits named: Opyn Live virtual urgent care, unlimited 24/7, (866) 668-6272 - MANDATORY TYPE service. Kindly Human peer support, 24/7 - MANDATORY TYPE service. BestChoice Rx prescription discount program, accepted nationwide, stated discounts up to 80% on over 10,000 medications with average savings over 65% per prescription - MANDATORY TYPE discount_program.

benefit.kindly_human.v: Kindly, Human - 24/7 peer support service for everyday challenges. Described as providing access to support, not clinical care.

billing.ach_authorization.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
billing.ach_authorization.v: Recurring billing authorization: remains in effect until cancelled IN WRITING, with at least 15 days written notice before the next billing date. ACH authorization may be revoked by contacting (732) 876-9733 no less than 3 business days before the date. Rejected transactions may be re-attempted at FirstEnroll's discretion within 30 days with an additional returned-payment fee charged as a separate transaction. The enrollee certifies they will not dispute scheduled transactions with their bank or card company. FirstEnroll address of record: 101 Crawfords Corner Rd, Suite #4233, Holmdel, NJ 07733; members@firstenroll.com.

cancellation.right_to_review.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
cancellation.right_to_review.v: 30-day right to review for cancellation from the plan effective date, available ONLY if no claims have been utilised - explicitly including any usage of the prescription program.

compliance.not_replacement.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
compliance.not_replacement.v: 'I agree that the membership plan I enrolled in does not replace Major Medical, Cobra, Medicare, Medicaid, or Medical Disability.' And: 'THIS IS A SUPPLEMENT TO HEALTH INSURANCE AND IS NOT A SUBSTITUTE FOR MAJOR MEDICAL COVERAGE. LACK OF MAJOR MEDICAL COVERAGE (OR OTHER MINIMUM ESSENTIAL COVERAGE) MAY RESULT IN AN ADDITIONAL PAYMENT WITH YOUR TAXES.'

compliance.state_mec_requirement.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
compliance.state_mec_requirement.v: 'Residents of California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Rhode Island and the District of Columbia can purchase a health insurance indemnity plan. However, they are required to maintain other health benefits/plans/policies, which is Minimum Essential benefit/plan/policy within the meaning of Section 5000A(f) of the Internal Revenue Code.'

eligibility.working_owner_attestation.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
eligibility.working_owner_attestation.v: The enrollee agrees: 'To maintain your status as a Working Owner, you agree that you intend to dedicate 20 hours per week to your business and/or you intend to earn compensation in excess of the cost of your benefit program.'

enrollment.affiliate_commission_structur.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
enrollment.affiliate_commission_structur.v: The enrollee is registered as an affiliate/Limited Partner and is offered COMMISSIONS: 'if you refer someone and they purchase via the referral link, commissions will be credited to the Partner. Commissions are paid the 15th of each month for the prior months sales and can be a good source of income to help offset your healthcare cost.' On or around the 15th of the following month the enrollee receives an email from affiliate@goodhealthdp.com containing a discount code good for 25% off a GHDP product.

enrollment.k1_tax_document.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
enrollment.k1_tax_document.v: 'NLP hereby agrees to receive all limited partnership tax documents, including annual Form K-1 documents, via the email address provided.'

exclusions.hospital_setting.v: None of the Preventive Health Services are covered if they are provided at a hospital.

exclusions.schedule_limited.v: This Plan does not cover services unless listed in the Schedule of Benefits.

legal.joinder_agreement.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
legal.joinder_agreement.v: Enrollment executes a GHD, LP NEW LIMITED PARTNER JOINDER AGREEMENT and a Gift/Return Agreement, both of which must be executed for either to take effect. The Limited Partnership Agreement is dated May 23, 2024 and is incorporated by reference in its entirety. The partnership interest is a GIFT: the enrollee affirms no investment of money or capital was made and has no expectation of profit. Interest may be diluted by later partners.

legal.not_securities.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
legal.not_securities.v: The agreement states the Limited Partnership Interest is not a security and is not subject to federal or state securities laws, and carries a capitalised legend that the interest has not been registered with the SEC under the Securities Act of 1933 or qualified under any state law.

network.out_of_network.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
network.out_of_network.v: 'Out of Network services will not be covered unless otherwise specified, and the Plan Member will owe 100% of the cost of these services.' Discount access via First Health Network using code 'FHMBA' or 1-877-858-1036.

network.restriction.v: Outpatient physician services and wellness benefits are limited to in-network providers only. Inpatient hospital indemnity benefits are NOT so limited.

plan_year.sec: TERMS panel - GHDP enrollment agreement / Limited Partner joinder
plan_year.v: Plan Year runs 7/1 to 6/30. All deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums and plan benefits reset on 7/1 each year.
